summary.title: Build an INSANE Twitch Clone | Flutter Live Streaming App with Backend | Agora
summary.one_liner: A chaptered video walkthrough of building a cross-platform live streaming app (Twitch clone) with Flutter, Firebase, Agora and a Go token-generation backend.
keywords: flutter web and macos firebase setup
how to build a live streaming app
takeaways: How to set up Firebase email/password auth and persist login state in a Flutter app
How to integrate Agora for live video broadcasting and joining channels in Flutter
How to generate Agora temporary tokens with a small Go API and call it over HTTP from Flutter
How to add go-live, thumbnail selection, realtime chat, screensharing and a responsive UI across Android, iOS, web and macOS
summary.summary: This is a roughly 4.5-hour YouTube video by Rivaan Ranawat that builds a Twitch-style live streaming app in Flutter. The chapter list shows it moves from project layout and onboarding/login UI, through Firebase setup for Android and iOS, to Agora integration (channel joining, token generation), realtime chat, and a Go backend for tokens. It later covers responsive layout, screensharing, macOS and web setup, and deployment. The page text is mostly the video's chapter list and description, so the depth of each step is not visible here.
